650-HORSEPOWER 6.2L SUPERCHARGED V8 ENGINE

650 HORSEPOWER. ZL1 is the reigning
AVAILABLE 10-SPEED PADDLE-SHIFT AUTOMATIC
king of Camaro performance, thanks TRANSMISSION
to its supercharged V8 engine, making
6-PISTON FRONT, 4-PISTON REAR BREMBO®
it the most powerful production BRAKE CALIPERS
Camaro ever built. It also boasts a PERFORMANCE TRACTION MANAGEMENT
whopping 650 lb.-ft. of torque. Its (COUPE ONLY)
foundation is the LT4 engine that helps
enable a top track speed of 198 mph
and a 0-to-60 mph time of 3.5 seconds.1
MANAGING THE POWER. The robust ZL1
powertrain is controlled by standard
equipment that includes Magnetic Ride
Control dampers, an electronically
controlled limited-slip differential,
Brembo® brakes with 6-piston front
calipers, and aerodynamic additions
such as a platform wing and front and
side splitters.
PUTTING THE POWER DOWN.
On a closed-course drag strip, custom
launch control keeps the rear tires
spinning at the correct speed and
allows you to adjust both your launch
rpm and wheel slippage through the
Driver Information Center. A line lock
feature lets you lock the front wheels
to enable the rear wheels to spin,
warming the tires for maximum grip.
SHOCKS THAT READ THE ROAD. Magnetic
Ride Control reads the road and changes
“ The ZL1 is a supercar that looks like a Camaro”.
damping in just 10-15 milliseconds in
shocks filled with a magnetorheological — Car and Driver
fluid containing minute iron particles.
An available Performance Traction
Management system helps achieve
